blocks.text: MABALACAT CITY, Pampanga — The former director and spokesperson of the Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC) is urging Philippine authorities to intensify their manhunt for former officers of a large Philippine offshore gaming operator (Pogo) in Porac, Pampanga. In a statement sent to the media on Tuesday, Sept. 29, Winston John Casio said Catherine Cassandra Li Ong and Ronelyn Bahan Baterna remain at large despite the filing of charges and the issuance of arrest warrants against them in May 2025. The two were allegedly officials of Lucky South 99 Corp. and Whirlwind Corp., which have been accused of labor trafficking for […]...
